browser_observation: responseHeadersSize was zero. A204response reports responseBodySize498, so the legacy body-size fields cannot be interpreted literally as pure HTTP bodies.
preferred_browser_label: Browser-reported encoded response/download bytes, including possible unsplit headers
do_not_add: Do not add main-page CDP encodedDataLength to cross-frame Playwright totals. Do not add an invented header estimate to totals that may already include headers.
api_contrast: HTTPX num_bytes_downloaded in production_visitor_load.py measures encoded response body chunks and was verified independently using a real gzip AsyncByteStream in the offline tests.
limitations: Browser HTTP headers cannot be separated accurately in these captures
TLS/retransmissions, failed-request partial payloads and persistent-connection traffic are not exact billing measurements
Cold HTTP-cache-disabled browser captures are not universal per-user allowances
Legacy numeric fields are preserved exactly; only their interpretation is clarified
